test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Last straw

options.text: The last ray of hope in an unfortunate situation
The only option left after a series of unsuccessful attempts
The final problem in a series of problems that makes the situation intolerable

solution:
The correct answer is **'The final problem in a series of problems that makes the situation intolerable'**.
